day_local: Isikhumbuzo sikaSaint Ignatius waseAntiyokiya, uBhishophu kunye noMfel'ukholo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen. Kwanga uThixo uBawo, owasithanda kwaye wasinika ithemba elingunaphakade, angaba nani nonke.
penitential:
Nkosi, uhlale unenceba.
Kristu, uhlale unenceba.
Nkosi, uhlale unenceba.
psalm_response: Nkosi, Nkosi wethu, ligama lakho elizukileyo phezu komhlaba wonke!
homily:
Kukho imizuzu apho umhlaba ubonakala ungenanto, apho ukuthula kwendlu kunzima ukukuthwala. Mhlawumbi uke wema ecaleni kwesango okanye kwibala leenqwelo-moya, ubukele iindiza zisuka, ucinga ngaloo mntu uphakathi kwethu owayekuthanda ukubukela iinjini neempiko zazo zinyuka ziye esibhakabhakeni. UBenjamin Vo wayenalo olo thando. Wayengumfana owayejonga phezulu, engajongi nje iindiza, kodwa ejonga ubukhulu bukaThixo obufihlakeleyo kwiimfihlo zenzululwazi kunye nobuchwephesha.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usicela ukuba sikhangele ngamehlo entliziyo. Uthi: 'Maye amehlo eentliziyo zenu akhanyiselwe, ukuze nazi ukuba liyintoni na ithemba elibangelwa kukubizwa kwakhe.' Amehlo entliziyo. Lawo ngamehlo angaboni nje izinto eziphathekayo, kodwa abona uthando lukaThixo olufihlakeleyo kuyo yonke imeko yobomi bethu. UBen wayengumfana owayenalo olo khanya. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayenentliziyo eyayikwazi ukubona abanye.

Khumbula lo mfanekiso: uBen, eneminyaka eli-15, efuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Ubenayo loo ntliziyo yayikwazi ukunikela ngayo yonke into ngaphandle kokubala. Loo ntliziyo yayicocekile, ingaphili ngemithetho yobuxoki yeli hlabathi, kodwa iphila ngenceba kaThixo. UBen wayengumfana owayethanda ukunika, owayethanda ukuba nomdla kwabanye, owayesoloko enoncumo olwaluthi, 'Ndikhona, ndiyakuthanda.'

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthi: 'Wonke umntu ovumayo phambi kwabantu, uNyana woMntu uya kumvuma phambi kweengelosi zikaThixo.' UBen wayengumfana owavuma uYesu ngendlela awayephila ngayo—ngobubele bakhe, ngothando lwakhe, nangokuzinikela kwakhe kusapho lwakhe. Wayengumfana owayesazi ukuba ubomi abupheleli apha emhlabeni. Uwayesazi ukuba i-'con chim airlines' yakhe yayingeyiyo nje eyokuhamba emhlabeni, kodwa yayiyindlela yokufikelela kwiimfihlo zikaThixo.

Kodwa Alan, Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule nyanga yesine emva kokuba uBen ebuyele kuThixo, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha njengomsinga ongaqondakaliyo. Kukho imibuzo eza ebusuku, kukho imizuzu apho uzibuza ukuba ngaba kukhona na eninokuze nako kwenza ngokwahlukileyo. Ndifuna ukuba uphulaphule inyaniso kaThixo namhlanje, kwaye uyivumele ingene nzulu entliziyweni yakho: akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala kwaphela. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto kulo mhlaba zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo ngokupheleleyo.

UYesu uthi: 'Musa ukoyika.' Lo ngumyalelo, kodwa ikwangulwazi oluphilisayo. UBen akalahlekanga. Usemkhono kaThixo, apho akukho ntlungu, apho akukho zifo, apho kukho kuphela uthando olungenasiphelo. UBen ukhangele phantsi kuwe Ryan, kwaye akakushiye. Xa udlala okanye ucinga ngekamva, yazi ukuba uBen ukuthembile, ukuthandile, kwaye usakuthanda kakhulu. UBen usengumntwana ononcumo, usengumntwana ocinga ngekamva, usengumntwana okhathalayo.

Namhlanje, masithathe oku: uBen wayengumfana owafunda ukunika. Masifunde nathi ukunika—ukunika iintlungu zethu kuThixo, ukunika ithemba lethu kuye, kwaye ukunika uthando lwethu kwabo basijikelezileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hamba ke namhlanje ukhululekile emthwalweni wokuzisola. Bamba isandla sikaYesu, uthembe ukuba uYisease usezintliziyweni zenu, kwaye uBen ulala ngokuthula ekhanyeni likaThixo, esikhangela sonke ngovuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kule Sakramente yothando. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela ngokwenyani, nceda uze kum ngomoya nangothando. Ndiyakwamkela, njengokungathi sele ufikile, kwaye ndizimanyanise nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze uvumele ukuba ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angakunika uxolo olugqithise ukuqonda kwethu. Hamba ngoxolo lweNkosi.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasemlilweni wosizi, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana noodade bethu: Ndivile ngokukholwa kwenu eNkosini uYesu, nangothando lwenu kwabangcwele bonke, andiyeki ukubulela ngenxa yenu, ndinikhumbula emithandazweni yam, ukuze uThixo weNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu, uYise wozuko, aninike umoya wobulumko nowesityhilelo ekumazini yena. Makukhanyiselwe amehlo eentliziyo zenu, ukuze nazi ukuba liyintoni na ithemba lobizo lwakhe, nokuba zithini na izityebi zozuko lwelifa lakhe phakathi kwabangcwele, nokuba liyintoni na ubukhulu obugqithisileyo bamandla akhe kuthi thina abakholwayo, ngokokusebenza kobukhulu bokuqina kwakhe, awakusebenzisayo kuKristu, emvusa kwabafileyo, emhlalisa ngasekunene kwakhe ezulwini, ngaphezu kwabo bonke abalawuli, amagunya, amandla, nobukhosana, nangaphezu kwalo lonke igama elibizwayo, kungekuphela kweli xesha, kodwa nakwelo liza kuza. Wayibeka yonke into phantsi kweenyawo zakhe, wamnika ukuba abe yintloko phezu kwezinto zonke eBandleni, elingumzimba wakhe, ukuzaliseka kwalowo uzalisa izinto zonke ngazo zonke iindlela.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Nkosi, Nkosi wethu, ligama lakho elizukileyo phezu komhlaba wonke! O Nkosi, Nkosi wethu, ligama lakho elizukileyo phezu komhlaba wonke! Wena owubeke uzuko lwakho phezu kwamazulu. Ngemilomo yeentsana neeyesele, umise indumiso ngenxa yeentshaba zakho. R. Nkosi, Nkosi wethu, ligama lakho elizukileyo phezu komhlaba wonke! Xa ndikhangela amazulu akho, umsebenzi weminwe yakho, inyanga neenkwenkwezi ozimisileyo—ungubani na umntu ukuba umkhumbule, okanye unyana womntu ukuba umhoye? R. Nkosi, Nkosi wethu, ligama lakho elizukileyo phezu komhlaba wonke! Umwenze waba ngaphantsi kancinci kuneengelosi, wamthwesa uzuko nembeko. Umbeke ukuba abe nolawulo phezu kwemisebenzi yezandla zakho, izinto zonke uzibeke phantsi kweenyawo zakhe. R. Nkosi, Nkosi wethu, ligama lakho elizukileyo phezu komhlaba wonke!

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe: Ndithi kuni, wonke umntu ovumayo phambi kwabantu, uNyana woMntu uya kumvuma phambi kweengelosi zikaThixo. Kodwa lowo undikhanyelayo phambi kwabantu, uya kukhanyelwa phambi kweengelosi zikaThixo. Wonke umntu othetha ilizwi elichasene noNyana woMntu uya kuxolelwa, kodwa lowo unyelisa uMoya oyiNgcwele akayi kuxolelwa. Xa benisa phambi kwees synagogue naphambi kwabalawuli namagunya, musani ukuxhalaba malunga nendlela okanye nento eya kuba lukhuselo lwenu okanye ngento eniya kuyithetha. Kuba uMoya oyiNgcwele uya kunifundisa ngaloo mzuzu into enimele niyithethe.

day: Memorial of Saint Ignatius of Antioch, Bishop and Martyr

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!
